# InspectReport AI

> AI home inspection report software for US home inspectors. Upload site photos, add short notes, and get a structured inspection report with severity badges, repair-cost estimates, and PDF export.

## What it does
- Turns photos + short field notes into a structured inspection report
- Severity badges on every finding
- Repair-cost estimates included in the report
- PDF export
- Live report preview while you build the report
- Estimates can be shared with clients by link: the client opens the estimate online (no account needed), can accept optional add-ons, and approves it with their name; the owner sees when it was viewed and when it was approved

## Pricing
- Free: account, reports, and live preview
- Free 3-day Pro trial for every new account: full access including PDF export, no credit card required
- Pro: $49/month flat per account after the trial — no per-inspector fees, no price that doubles after a promo period

## Who it's for
- Solo home inspectors and small inspection teams in the US who write reports from field photos and notes
- Home-repair pros (plumbing, roofing, painting, tile & flooring, handyman, HVAC, electrical) who document jobs for customers — each report can be an "Inspection Report" or a "Job Report"
